sourceMethods: All 128 current subnet profiles, 100 September 11–12 channel briefs, and earlier published editions reviewed for fresh developments and corrections.

Signed-in X Latest: broad Bittensor/TAO search plus 16 grouped searches covering SN1–128 and names/aliases. 152 public account candidates checked, 147 accessible, with 131 unique in-window post records. Selected posts, replies and articles followed to full text. Additional MicroTensor and Ditto original posts checked.

Signed-in Grok supplied specific original-post leads, checked against primary sources before use. External coverage included Opentensor, Chainlink, ForeverMoney, StonkFun, Sunrise, BaseStonk, BUTT, CONST and Shizzy.

Signed-in AlphaGap feed reviewed across recent and earlier cards. SubnetRadar, TAO Daily, TAO Media and the public subnet feed provided further discovery. Conflicting summaries were checked against dated releases and current documentation.

156 repository paths scanned with pagination from the prior cutoff and refreshed through 8:08 AM ET. Selected full patches, npm publication timestamps, project pages and Bittensor’s emissions documentation checked.
Latest SubnetRadar Moments feed reviewed; 52 unique linked events within the coverage window retained. Registration and conviction-event detail pages checked.
Market and emissions snapshot at 8:08 AM ET compared with yesterday’s saved snapshot. Price comparisons use rolling 24-hour alpha/TAO changes; slot-reset changes are treated separately.

YouTube Videos and Live checked. New Shiz Cat replay verified on its watch page: 1,642 seconds, ended September 11 at 23:31:41 UTC, with a public embed. No new upcoming stream or newer members upload found in the samples.
accessGaps: Signed-in X Latest searches covered all 128 subnet numbers and names in 16 groups, but only initial visible results were sampled. Public account timelines were also sampled rather than exhaustively paginated. Private, deleted, unindexed and unsampled material may be missing; this is not a claim to have captured every post.

Private Discord history was not directly accessed. Stories sourced to channel digests remain developing, including Vanta’s trader milestone, Reliquary’s key recovery, ORO’s delay, Sundaebar’s closing date, Perturb buybacks and operational reports. A team attribution in a digest is not independent verification of the original speaker or event.

Leadpoet’s reward settlement is separate from its launch and code promotion. RedTeam’s banks are unnamed and integrations are in progress. No signed banking contracts, customer revenue, or separately audited commercial accounts were established.

Cascade’s multivariate scoring gate remains ahead of the chain snapshot. The 4M-versus-91M comparison circulating in today’s TAO Daily article originates on August 10 and was not reported as a new benchmark. Yanez’s npm publication was verified against the registry; its CLI and MCP packages remain unpublished.

Allocation snapshots do not prove administrative enable/disable transactions or individual miner payouts. Witness’s full-burn setting is verified in code; every validator’s deployed version and final revealed weights were not reconstructed.

SN35 registration details come from SubnetRadar’s chain-derived event record, not an independent replay of the extrinsic. Its successor project identity remains unconfirmed. Large percentage changes across a re-registration were excluded from the normal price comparison. A Grok lead naming a new SN76 project lacked sufficient primary evidence and was not promoted.

Ridges returned HTTP 429 with a browser security checkpoint to the direct site check. Current upload reopening was not verified. Five repository paths were inaccessible; per-path errors and replacement paths are retained in the audit.

StonkFun and BUTT financial figures are attributed to their public reports and were not reconciled against all transactions. About $500,000 in StonkFun’s dated revenue report belongs to delayed prior-day claims. Small conviction additions were recorded in the audit; no verified forward unlock calendar or material new lock reduction was established.

No distinct new CONST product launch, named Yanez customer deal or confirmed Score/Shell partnership was established. Member allegations and promotional price predictions were excluded. The Shiz Cat replay explicitly concerns the site creator’s own token experiment.
Research ran through 8:08 AM ET on September 12. Source refreshes occurred at different times within the scan; later announcements need the next update. Prior dated reports are preserved.
